notablePrerequisites: An additional creature with flying and indestructible on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes' ability by sacrificing itself to deal 4 damage to the creature with flying and indestructible.
Aerie Ouphes's Persist ability triggers, returning Aerie Ouphes from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on all creatures you control.
The -1/-1 counter and +1/+1 counter on Aerie Ouphes are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.
